item.title: Mila Antonova and the Nuclear Physicist: Who Are the 2 Russian Women With Whom Bill Gates Had Affairs?
item.description: Bill Gates apologised to foundation staff for his "huge mistake" in associating with Jeffrey Epstein. item.title: Business News | Uncle Peter's Pancakes Celebrates 2nd Edition of National Pancake Day with Record-Breaking Response Across 110+ Outlets
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. item.title: Business News | Electrolux Expands Retail Presence with Launch of Exclusive Brand Store in Dehradun
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], February 26: Electrolux, the global Swedish home appliance brand with over a century of expertise in shaping living for the better, has announced the launch of its exclusive Brand Store in Dehradun in partnership with A Star Enterprise. The new store marks a significant step in strengthening Electrolux's retail presence in India and bringing its premium appliance portfolio closer to consumers in Uttarakhand.
